intro: Lesotho, the 'Kingdom in the Sky', is a mountain kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa.

chapters.title: King Moshoeshoe
text: In the 1820s King Moshoeshoe I gathered people fleeing wars into a nation, the Basotho, defending them from the mountain fortress of Thaba Bosiu.

highlight.title: Founder
highlight.text: Moshoeshoe I is honoured as the father of the nation.

chapters.title: Basutoland
text: To avoid takeover by the Boers, Moshoeshoe asked Britain for protection in 1868. Basutoland stayed separate from South Africa.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Lesotho became independent in 1966 as a kingdom. Coups and political crises have occurred, but elections continue.
